result.detail: No formal_spec file was submitted. The microarchitecture plans an unbounded proof with an independent reference model and covers, plus a second job at N=32. The evidence rule accepts exactly one formal_spec per submission, so that work fits better as a follow-up task than as an unverified addition here. Reviewers and design.rtl.interface.tech_lead should decide whether the formal requirement in section 8 of the interface spec is tracked separately. The in-RTL assertions under `ifdef FORMAL` are design-intent only and are not a proof. The decode assumes ADDR_WIDTH >= 6; the spec requires only 8. The testbench drives inputs after the falling edge and samples combinational outputs 1 ns later.
